apps.name: Voyplan
apps.subtitle: AI travel planner — routes, budget, bookings, gallery.
apps.localizedDescription: Voyplan is an AI-powered travel planner: plan one-way road trips or AI round trips, get a time-blocked itinerary with budget (fuel, tolls, flights, hotels, food), pick your vehicle, browse AI flight/train/hotel suggestions, start an active-trip today view, and keep a travel photo gallery.
apps.versionDescription: Latest build: AI planning (Gemini), international budgets, booking suggestions, Start Trip active view, and travel gallery.

versions.localizedDescription: Latest build: AI planning (Gemini), international budgets, booking suggestions, Start Trip active view, and travel gallery.
